Explain why the base angles of an isosceles triangle are equal, using a rigid motion.
items.answer: Reflecting the triangle over the perpendicular bisector of the base maps the two equal sides onto each other and the triangle onto itself, carrying one base angle onto the other, so they are equal.

steps: A reflection over the symmetry line swaps the base angles.
